system.description:
This skill only produces an effect when you are equipped with a [Bow]. You may reduce the [Hate] cost of «Maestro Echo» and «Exceptional Blow» to 0.

(SR2): Increase the range of [Bows] you are equipped with by +1.
(SR3): You can use «Repeat Note» with [Range: 4 Sq.]

A fighting style in which the bow is handled with the elegance of plucking a lyre. The pure sound of strings echoes with each arrow that is fired, inspiring allies.
